name: TREC Question Classification Dataset
description: The TREC Question Classification dataset is an academic benchmark created by Xin Li and Dan Roth (COLING 2002) for classifying open-domain English questions into semantic target types. Built around a two-layered taxonomy comprising 6 coarse classes (Abbreviation, Entity, Description, Human, Location, Numeric Value) and 50 fine-grained subcategories, the dataset contains 5,452 training questions curated from various QA collections and a test set of 500 questions from the TREC 10 Question Answering track (total: 5,952 questions).

provenance.collection_method: Aggregated from TREC QA tracks and various online question collections.
provenance.curation_notes: Annotated manually into a 2-tier semantic taxonomy (6 coarse classes, 50 fine classes).
